description: This PHP source file defines the GetFieldListParams class in the Api\V8\Param namespace, which extends BaseParam. It appears to be part of an API for handling parameters related to listing fields within a module in the SuiteCRM project. The class includes methods to get the module name and configure parameter options, utilizing Symfony's OptionsResolver.

classes.name: GetFieldListParams
classes.description: Class representing parameters for retrieving a list of fields from a module, extending BaseParam, with methods to access the module name and configure options.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module name from the parameters array.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Configures the options resolver with specific options, notably the module name option.
